resources.string:
Chronicle plays from the files of your own copy of Dark Cloud. Make a disc image (ISO) of your PlayStation 2 disc, put it on this phone, and choose it here.

The US (NTSC-U) and European (PAL) releases are supported; the Japanese (NTSC-J) release is experimental.

The game's data, about 1.5 GB, is copied out of the image once. The image itself is left as it is.
